queries.q: I have a prioritized action plan saved from last week's planning session; run its Section 7 prompts in order and pause for my approval after each one.
Chain deliver-prd into deliver-user-stories against this feature brief so the story skill picks up the PRD's confirmed output automatically.
Before we spend real tokens on it, walk through the whole three-skill sequence in dry-run mode so I can see what would run and whether the chain even parses.
queries.notes: Names the readiness-probe flag but is otherwise a Mode B ad-hoc chain request; still this skill's territory.

queries.q: Run competitive-analysis, then the founding hypothesis, then experiment-design back to back, and don't stop to ask me after each one unless something actually fails or comes back empty.
queries.notes: Guarded-auto run mode (stop on failed/empty, otherwise no pause) is this skill's own semantics.

queries.q: We keep manually copying the output of one PM skill into the next for this same three-step process every sprint; is there a way to just run them as one sequence with a pause between each?
queries.notes: Intent-only, no artifact or skill-name keyword; describes checkpointed multi-skill execution.

queries.q: I want journey-map and problem-statement chained so the second step automatically receives the confirmed artifact from the first, not something I re-paste myself.
queries.notes: Describes the --thread dependency behavior without naming it.

queries.q: Run the ad-hoc chain: foundation-persona, then discover-journey-map, then deliver-prd, using the same customer context for all three.
Use /chain to run define-hypothesis and then measure-experiment-design on this pricing idea.
queries.notes: The chain command is the terse front door for Mode B; this is the same skill's territory.

queries.q: Execute my saved action plan's ranked list of next efforts end to end, and stop the whole run if any step comes back empty or fails.
Is there a way to run a handful of pm-skills as one continuous sequence, checkpointing after each, instead of me babysitting and re-invoking each one by hand?
queries.notes: Fully intent-only, no skill names or artifact keywords at all; the strongest routing test.

queries.q: We keep running the same three skills by hand every time we kick off a new feature; can you turn that repeated sequence into a permanent workflow I can invoke by name later?
queries.notes: Promoting a repeated chain into a durable, authored workflow is the builder's job; the orchestrator only runs a sequence once, it never authors one.

queries.q: I have a chain expression from a /chain run that worked really well; capture it as a proper workflow file and command so the rest of the team can reuse it.
queries.notes: Chain-promotion is explicitly the workflow builder's entry form, not a run request.

queries.q: I just have a pile of messy notes from a leadership sync and I'm not sure what to prioritize; what should I actually do next?
queries.notes: Wants the ranked next-action plan produced from scratch, not an existing plan's steps executed; the orchestrator's own When NOT to Use calls this out.

queries.q: Here's the PRD I just drafted for the checkout redesign; tell me what's weak or missing before I send it to engineering.
queries.notes: Single-artifact adversarial review, not a multi-step run; the orchestrator's own When NOT to Use routes this to pm-critic.

queries.q: Check whether a newer pm-skills release is out and bring my local install up to date.
queries.notes: Library-maintenance machinery; the orchestrator explicitly refuses Tier-3 maintenance skills and this is one of the named ones.

queries.q: Summarize what happened in yesterday's roadmap review for the folks who couldn't make it.
queries.notes: Plain single-skill meeting recap request with no sequencing or multi-step intent.

queries.q: Run our whole Foundation Sprint end to end this week, from basics through the founding hypothesis.
queries.notes: A fixed, curated, author-maintained multi-skill workflow (the workflow-foundation-sprint command) is explicitly out of scope per When NOT to Use; the command has no backing skill directory so no near_miss_of is set.

queries.q: My Postgres migration script keeps timing out on the big customers table; can you help me debug it?
Draft the launch checklist for the mobile app release covering legal, support, and marketing readiness.
queries.notes: Single-artifact production request; no sequencing of multiple skills implied.

queries.q: Plan a team offsite in Denver for next quarter, need agenda and logistics.
